tools.name: feedletter_list_surveys
tools.description: List or search your FeedLetter surveys (newsletter surveys, one-time polls and web rating widgets), newest first, 50 per page. q matches the name, id or external_id. Each item has id, type, name, external_id, public_title and created_at. While has_more is true, call again with page + 1. Read-only. F

tools.name: feedletter_get_survey
tools.description: Get one survey by its FeedLetter survey id: settings, placement code (links or embed_html), analytics (votes, daily votes, sentiment) and all feedback. Set results_only to true for just the identity, analytics and feedback. Use the survey id, not the external_id. Read-only. FeedLetter API: GET /v2/s

tools.name: feedletter_get_wall_of_love
tools.description: Get the feedback that one Wall of Love shows, to build your own wall. Each item has id, comment, name (when shown), answer_label, created_at and survey_title. Comment and name are HTML-escaped. Business plan only: other plans get 403 plan_required. Read-only. FeedLetter API: GET /v2/walls-of-love/{i

tools.name: feedletter_create_survey
tools.description: Create a newsletter survey, a one-time poll or a web rating widget. Needs a Read & write key. Only type and name are required. Newsletter and poll responses return links (one voting link per answer) and email_html; web ratings return embed_html. Set external_id to your own stable id: a second call w

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: feedletter_get_wall_of_love, feedletter_create_survey · Public sink: feedletter_create_survey.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: feedletter_get_wall_of_love, feedletter_create_survey · Public sink: feedletter_create_survey

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
